mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 4% for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 2% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1% signals improving supply capacity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 1% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% combined with a 3-month decline in average hourly earnings (HOUST) above 1% signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and HOUST falls > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and HOUST falls > 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 2% combined with a 6-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 5% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 2% and HOUST falls > 5% over 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% and HOUST falls > 5% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months), a 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4% signals a synchronized labor and monetary tightening, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakening
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
